title: whatsapp_inbox._link_customer_threads
description: The payload of `customer.created` / `customer.updated`, verbatim — a manifest listener has no mapping layer. It is the saved customer sheet plus the runtime's system binds; `new_id` is NOT the card of a creation (the runtime binds a fresh one to the listener), so the handler identifies the card by the `customers.list` read. Nothing is required and anything is accepted: a stricter schema would not degrade the link, it would dead-letter the customer event for this listener. The handler links nobody when the payload carries no phone.
